steps.title: Define App Configuration
steps.description: Establish app-meta.json containing application metadata for RemindMe Pro.

steps.title: Establish Build Steps
steps.description: Re-establish build steps outlining the UI 3D redesign process for RemindMe Pro.

steps.title: Define 3D-Oriented Color Palette
steps.description: Configure colors.xml with soft gradients, deep shadows, and distinct accent highlights to create depth.

steps.title: Create Skeuomorphic Header Background
steps.description: Create a layer-list drawable representing an extruded 3D action bar with subtle bottom shadows.

steps.title: Create 3D Card Background Style
steps.description: Implement a layer-list card background simulating depth via distinct layered shadow steps and crisp outer strokes.

steps.title: Create Interactive 3D Clickable Button Style
steps.description: Implement a state-list selector button that renders an extrusion shadow when idle and translates downward when pressed.

steps.title: Create Interactive 3D Clickable Delete Button Style
steps.description: Apply 3D depth and displacement logic specifically for the alert/danger styled round buttons.

steps.title: Create Sunken Inset Input Background style
steps.description: Create a sunken inset look for text inputs by using multiple offsets mimicking shadows on internal borders.

steps.title: Create 3D Clickable Secondary Button Style
steps.description: Implement a neutral-shaded 3D button selector for date and time picker dialog targets.

steps.title: Create Inset Status Badge Style
steps.description: Create a pill-styled inset status badge to present Active and Expired statuses with a Neumorphic look.

steps.title: Apply 3D Theme to Main Activity Layout
steps.description: Update activity_main.xml to deploy the 3D Header Bar and place the empty state text within a beautifully extruded card container.

steps.title: Apply 3D Theme to Reminder Item Layout
steps.description: Update reminder_item.xml to configure proper layout margins and leverage the 3D depth card background without shadow clipping.

steps.title: Apply 3D Theme to Add Reminder Dialog Layout
steps.description: Update dialog_add_reminder.xml to structure inputs using sunken input styles and clickable 3D action triggers.

steps.title: Building RemindMe Pro
steps.description: Compile updated resources and code using the fixed environment parameters to verify 3D styling integrity.
